external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Lena Nagel decided to spend a semester abroad at the USB Stellenbosch in Cape Town, mainly due to academic reasons. "The university has an excellent reputation and is one of the two top business schools in South Africa. In addition, the country attracted me greatly, she says. The 26 year-old gathered plenty of positive impressions in her luggage before returning to Germany and now goes through the world with a more open-minded attitude.

The ISM offers several programs in close collaboration with valued external partners. Some of these include the Business Preparation Program (BPP) offered in partnership with Wit-Rising Education and Technology (China), the collaboration with upGrad (partnership with Indian and US universities), or the cooperation with the Helvetic Business School (Switzerland).
Marketing, e-commerce & social media: internship at Milupa

After completing her studies, she went for her dream job: For Stefanie Hauber, her career dream has become reality. The ISM graduate entered product marketing at Audi AG immediately after completing her Master's degree in Strategic Marketing Management. She is responsible for Audi‘s A8-series strategy and the creation of marketing concepts. "Especially the many interfaces to other departments and business areas make my job incredibly exciting," reports Stefanie.
[Raphael Brinkert, Managing Director Jung von Matt/sports]
